purpose: Guarantee that scoreable reflection/still evidence uses the already-developed physical generated facade or the exact persisted authored danchi representation that was present before the reflection baseline. Generated fallback mode freezes scene/root identities; authored mode additionally freezes a deterministic SHA-256 over the danchi art slot/root, persisted transform and visibility state, renderer mesh/material asset dependencies, and LOD configuration across Unity script/assembly reloads. No source-side binding may award Visual Fidelity points without actual native 4K pixels.
formalPreparationOrder: select exactly one danchi.main art slot and resolve authored-versus-generated representation
if generated fallback: build/validate DanchiFacadeApertureShell physical rough openings, metric aperture UVs, deterministic occupancy variation and 4 mm glass perimeter edges
if authored: require one active persisted authored prefab/model instance, inactive fallback, persisted scene membership and renderable renderer set

before reflection baseline, compute authored representation SHA-256 from scene GUID, stable slot/authored/fallback GlobalObjectIds, authored prefab dependency hash, persisted hierarchy transforms/visibility, renderer mesh/material dependency hashes and LOD state
freeze generated stable root identities or authored SHA-256 into UnityEditor.SessionState
registered material + physical UV + facade formal-build validation
every reflection poll/completion/pre-still call recomputes the current read-only identity/fingerprint and fails closed on drift

reflectionLifecyclePolicy.newPreparationEpochIdentity: Clean Unity Editor session + benchmark scene GUID + authored/fallback mode. Generated mode binds persisted GlobalObjectIds for optics/aperture/occupancy. Authored mode binds a persisted authored-representation SHA-256.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.firstPreProbeFingerprint: May build a genuinely missing generated pass only in fallback mode. Authored mode never repairs or rewrites authored art; it validates one persisted active danchi.main replacement, requires inactive fallback, computes the representation fingerprint, then arms SessionState.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.authoredFingerprintCoverage: Schema facade-authored-evidence-v1 covers stable slot/authored/fallback identities, authored source prefab/model path+GUID+AssetDatabase dependency hash, persisted hierarchy activeSelf/local transforms, renderer enabled/shadow/reflection state, shared mesh asset identity+dependency hash, ordered shared material identity+dependency hashes, and LODGroup/LOD thresholds plus renderer membership.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.assemblyReload: The armed epoch and authored fingerprint survive script/domain reload through UnityEditor.SessionState. Reload is not permission to rebuild, replace, mutate or re-arm facade representation.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.subsequentEditorPolls: Must not write runtime reports or rebuild scene state. They verify scene GUID and authored/fallback mode. Generated mode validates exact stable roots and physical construction. Authored mode deterministically recomputes the representation fingerprint and requires an exact SHA-256 match.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.inFlightMutation: Generated root replacement, authored slot/root replacement, transform/visibility changes, prefab/model/mesh/material dependency edits, LOD changes, authored/fallback mode switching, scene GUID drift, or an unsaved replacement object is a hard failure; no automatic repair is permitted while reflection evidence may be in flight.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.legacyAuthoredEpoch: If SessionState says an authored epoch is armed but the schema-1.2 authored fingerprint is absent, fail closed and require a clean Editor restart. Never grandfather pre-1.2 authored evidence.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.resetBoundary: A clean Unity Editor restart is the conservative boundary for arming a fresh facade formal-build epoch.

requiredEvidence: hero/facade_center at 3840x2160 plus 100% review for repeated occupancy/modules, opaque fallback intrusion, authored replacement seating and window construction
oblique/construction_depth at 3840x2160 plus 100% crop for facade depth, authored/generated interface seating, perimeter seals, glazing/curtain ordering and light leaks
grazing/sash_rail_response at 3840x2160 plus 100% crop for physical UV scale, authored/generated material response, sash/seal/glass interfaces and non-painted grazing response
grazing/material_grazing and temporal pixels at 100% for material dependency continuity, concrete/module repetition, LOD changes, thin-edge shimmer and reflection continuity
limitations: This binding proves evidence-state identity/coherence only; it does not prove that authored or generated pixels are photorealistic.
Stable GlobalObjectId, AssetDatabase dependency hashes, deterministic SHA-256 and SessionState are provenance controls, not visual scoring evidence.

The authored fingerprint intentionally covers persisted render dependencies and render-affecting hierarchy/LOD state, but it does not inspect arbitrary runtime MaterialPropertyBlock values, animation time, procedural shader globals or external native-plugin state; formal capture guards must keep such mutable inputs deterministic.

Source-side geometry/metadata validation cannot clear obvious_repetition, major_light_leak, hero_geometry_intersection, visible LOD pop, aliasing/shimmer or any other visual critical defect without actual native render evidence.

Unity 6000.3.0f1 compilation, SessionState behavior, GlobalObjectId stability, AssetDatabase dependency-hash stability, scene serialization order, reflection-probe execution and 3840x2160 rendered output remain runtime verification pending until a Runner is available.
A clean Editor restart intentionally permits a new formal epoch; external render-candidate freshness/provenance guards remain responsible for tying that epoch to the exact candidate revision.
Existing generated passes and authored replacement art are validated rather than silently regenerated so evidence-state drift fails closed instead of being hidden during a formal packet.
